subtask: Move forward along the path, bearing slightly to the right.
end_condition: a round stone basin with a bamboo spout is visible ahead (it may still be small and far)

subtask: Keep moving forward toward the round stone basin with the bamboo spout.
start_condition: a round stone basin with a bamboo spout is visible ahead (it may still be small and far)
end_condition: the round stone basin with the bamboo spout is at least half the image width and has moved to the right edge of the image

subtask: Stop when the round stone basin with the bamboo spout is directly in front of you and fills the centre of the camera view.
start_condition: the round stone basin with the bamboo spout is at least half the image width and has moved to the right edge of the image
end_condition: the round stone basin with the bamboo spout fills the entire image from top to bottom and is centered
